messages:
Ben Ortiz: FYI - EnterpriseHealth (sales opp EH-993) just pushed an urgent compliance checklist. they want SOC2 Type II evidence + HIPAA BAA + 7yr audit log retention + EU data residency. asking for timeline and gating items.
SupportBot: New ticket created: #54821 linked to Zendesk. contact: laura@enterprisehealth.com. priority: high.
Cori Patel: reassigning to product/security sync. Ben can you paste the exact asks or attach questionnaire?
Ben Ortiz: pasted snippet from their email:
```
We need: SOC2 Type II report or audit-readiness plan, signed BAA, encrypted-at-rest with customer-managed KMS, immutable audit logs retained 7 years, data residency EU (FR or DE), ability to purge patient PII on request, and evidence of access controls & monitoring. Delivery needed for procurement review in 6 weeks to close.
```
Amy Schultz: tagging security — this touches SOC2, HIPAA, KMS + retention policy. quick Q: do they require HSM-backed keys or is KMS CMK enough?
Ben Ortiz: they explicitly said "customer-managed KMS (BYOK) + HSM preferred" in call notes.
Alice Kim: product note — we currently support KMS integrations for Dedicated/Private, but hosted API only supports Redwood-managed keys. Also retention controls/audit export are partial (logs stored 90 days in console, export endpoints exist).
Mike Zhang: engineering perspective: to meet 7yr immutable retention we need long-term writable blob store + WORM mode or signed append-only exports to object storage. That is non-trivial for hosted tier. approx effort: 4-6 sprint work to add retention policies + secure export pipeline and validation.
Cori Patel: proposal: split into must-have vs nice-to-have for closing the deal now. Must-have (for procurement sign-off): BAA signed, SOC2 compliance statement (Type II report or attestation timeline), BYOK/KMS for customer in Dedicated/Private, and documented retention controls or formal export plan. Nice-to-have: 7yr built-in immutable logs in hosted, full EU-managed object residency for hosted tier.
Amy Schultz: acceptance criteria draft for "closeable MVP":
- Signed BAA available
- SOC2 Type II report OR SOC2 readiness letter + timeline to Type II within 6 months
- Option to deploy in Dedicated or Private with customer-managed KMS (BYOK) documented
- Log export API + runbook that allows customer to ship logs to their EU bucket (S3) with instructions
- Data deletion API and proof-of-delete process for PHI requests
- Security contact & weekly checkpoint during onboarding

If we can commit to that, procurement typically accepts a plan and contractual SLA timelines.
Ben Ortiz: customer will accept staging in Dedicated region if we can show BYOK + export runbook immediately. they want commitment on 7yr retention but will accept exported logs to their EU bucket as stopgap.
Mike Zhang: given that, we can scope an "onboarding playbook" for Dedicated: BYOK guide + export pipeline + runbook for archiving logs to customer S3 with lifecycle rules to reach 7 years. Estimated effort: 2 sprints for docs + automation, 3-4 sprints for hardened export pipeline if we add verification and immutability.
Cori Patel: prioritization ask to PD: can we slot playbook + BYOK docs + export automation into next release train as a customer-driven item (blocker for enterprise sales)? propose priority P0 for onboarding flow, P1 for hosted native long-retention.
Alice Kim: risks: contractual language for retention needs legal signoff (defers to P0), plus we must be explicit about what we will host vs what customer hosts. Also note cross-region egress & cost implications.
Amy Schultz: security actions: 1) draft BAA template (we have baseline, will tailor) 2) SOC2 readiness statement + gap list 3) KMS/BYOK runbook for Dedicated/Private 4) log export validation checklist. I'll start 1 & 2 today.
Ben Ortiz: sales asks for a conservative timeline to tell the customer — what's realistic if we commit to the onboarding playbook path?
Mike Zhang: conservative: playbook + BYOK docs + export runbook = 4 weeks. hardened export with immutability verification = additional 6-8 weeks. SOC2 Type II if not already available = depends on audit calendar (likely 3-6 months).
Cori Patel: OK — messaging to customer: we can sign BAA and deploy them into Dedicated with BYOK and log export within 4 weeks; full native 7yr immutable hosted retention is a roadmap item ~10-12 weeks. We'll need legal & account engineering in the loop.
Ben Ortiz: I'll update EH contact and propose the timeline. will send a short one-pager tonight.
DeployBot: Opportunity EH-993 updated in Salesforce. stage -> Contracting.
SupportBot: Ticket #54821 updated: assigned to product/security.
Amy Schultz: next steps for internal owners: @Mike Zhang take onboarding automation (export pipeline) / @Alice Kim draft product-side comms and constraints / @Cori Patel own prioritization note for PD meeting. I'll own BAA + SOC2 readiness note.
Mike Zhang: ack, starting spike tomorrow for export verification and EU bucket pattern.
Alice Kim: ack, will draft a short "what we will deliver" doc for sales language.
Cori Patel: thanks team — I'll put this on PD agenda tomorrow and ask for P0 approval. Ben please add any procurement docs to the Zendesk ticket. :thumbsup:
